xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-1641: Run agents on local GPU models via a managed Ollama sidecar

plan.title: Run agents on local GPU models via a managed Ollama sidecar
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Overdeck agents can only run on cloud models. Operators with a 24 GB GPU (RTX 3090 Ti, Apple M4) want zero-cost, fully private agents on a local model such as Gemma 4 12B. The original plan targeted the Pi/ohmypi harness, which no longer exists as a runtime on main (pi folds into ohmypi, and ohmypi is being removed by PAN-4003).
narratives.Proposal: Serve local models through Ollama (>= 0.14, verified 0.19.0 on this host) using its native Anthropic Messages endpoint, and run them on the claude-code harness with the existing ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL provider pattern. Model ids are ollama:<tag>; the prefix routes to a new ollama provider and is stripped at the single launch-arg door (apiLaunchModelId). A preflight in getProviderEnvForModel checks health, version, and model presence, starts ollama serve lazily, warm-loads the model, and pins Claude Code's context window to the server's real num_ctx. pan install detects Ollama and offers the gemma4:12b pull, pan doctor reports it, pan up starts it only when config names an ollama: model, and an Overdeck-spawned agent completes PAN-3684 with zero cloud model calls.
narratives.NonGoals:
- ohmypi / pi harness support or ~/.omp/agent/models.json provisioning (PAN-4003 removes ohmypi)
- Codex --oss, opencode, kimi-code, acp, or muse on Ollama
- Generalizing src/lib/openai-compatible-proxy.ts for Ollama
- Dashboard model picker entries, a Settings provider card/toggle, or adding ollama to CONFIGURABLE_PROVIDERS
- Remote (non-localhost) Ollama hosts and remote (Fly.io) workspaces with ollama: models
- Gemma 3 support; DeepSeek V4 (route via OpenRouter)
- Automatic Ollama installation (curl | sh) on any platform
- Pricing rows or cost dashboards for local models (they record $0)
- Hardcoded model fallback to gemma4:12b in model resolution
- Changing the conversation-search embeddings path or ensureOllama() behavior
- Merging the PAN-3684 acceptance PR

autoDecisions.summary: Run Ollama models on the claude-code harness instead of Pi.
autoDecisions.rationale: pi is not a runtime on main and ohmypi is being removed (PAN-4003). Ollama 0.19.0 here serves POST /v1/messages with streaming tool_use, and claude --print completed a turn against it, so the existing ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL provider pattern works with no shim.

autoDecisions.summary: Address local models as ollama:<tag> and strip the prefix in apiLaunchModelId.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches PAN-3684 and the archived branch; tags can contain '/', so a colon namespace checked first avoids the OpenRouter slash heuristic; apiLaunchModelId is already the single launch-arg door for every --model flag.

autoDecisions.summary: Use a top-level ollama: YAML block (base_url, context_length) instead of models.providers.ollama.
autoDecisions.rationale: models.providers is keyed by CONFIGURABLE_PROVIDERS, which also drives the dashboard Settings union and tier-fitness warnings; the dashboard is follow-up scope and Ollama needs no key or enable toggle.

autoDecisions.summary: Pin Claude Code's context window to the context_length Ollama reports for the warm-loaded model; default server context 65536 when Overdeck starts ollama serve.
autoDecisions.rationale: Claude Code assumed 200K while the server enforced 32768 in the probe, and Ollama truncates silently; the server's own number is the only reliable source.

autoDecisions.summary: pan up starts Ollama only when the config names an ollama: model; install gives guidance and an optional pull (default No), never auto-installs.
autoDecisions.rationale: Avoids starting a GPU server on hosts that never opted in; commit 625bb71f62b blocked curl|sh auto-install on purpose.

autoDecisions.summary: Run the E2E through PAN-3684 using the workspace-built CLI and kill the agent right after evidence capture.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan reload deploys origin/main, so the production dashboard cannot route ollama: ids before merge; the archived review rejected direct-binary evidence.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep install/doctor/pan-up in this issue under plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of splitting a sibling issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's acceptance criteria name pan install and pan up explicitly; the file count comes from per-slice tests, ratchet allowlist rows, and docs, not from a sprawling change.

items.title: Add agent-facing Ollama health, start, and warm-load helpers

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. In src/lib/ollama.ts add and export DEFAULT_OLLAMA_AGENT_MODEL='gemma4:12b' (recommended pull target only, never a resolution fallback), MIN_OLLAMA_VERSION='0.14.0', OLLAMA_MODEL_PREFIX='ollama:', export the existing SAFE_OLLAMA_HOST_RE, stripOllamaPrefix(), isOllamaInstalled() (async spawn of `ollama --version`), checkOllamaHealth(tag, baseUrl, {fetchImpl, timeoutMs=5000}) returning {endpointReachable, version, versionSupported, modelPresent, message} with ONE AbortController bounding /api/version + /api/tags headers AND body, ensureOllamaServeRunning({baseUrl, contextLength, knownUnhealthy, deadlineMs=30000, fetchImpl, startServer, now, sleep}) that skips the pre-start probe when knownUnhealthy, starts `ollama serve` detached with OLLAMA_HOST and OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH env, and polls with per-attempt timeout min(5000, remaining) and 1000ms gaps until one overall deadline, and warmOllamaModel(tag, baseUrl) that POSTs /api/generate {model, prompt:''} (timeout 120000) then reads context_length for the tag from GET /api/ps. Keep ensureOllama() signature and behavior unchanged for the embeddings caller. No execSync, no sync fs. Tests use vi.useFakeTimers() + vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(); never real waits. Reference shape: `git show origin/archive/pan-1641-pre-cut:src/lib/ollama.ts`.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-10 (implementation checkpoint; follow its decision rules exactly). 1) npm run build in this workspace; confirm ollama >= 0.14.0; `ollama pull gemma4:12b`. 2) `gh issue edit 3684 --repo eltmon/overdeck` to replace 'Pi work agent' with 'claude-code work agent'. 3) From this workspace run `node dist/cli/index.js start PAN-3684 --model ollama:gemma4:12b --harness claude-code` (the production dashboard runs origin/main and cannot route ollama: ids before merge). Planning-time `pan start PAN-3684 --dry-run` found the existing workspace workspaces/feature-pan-3684 and its 1-item plan with no gate; if start refuses on a gate, `pan tell flywheel-orchestrator` with the message and stop — never pass --force. 4) Capture: the agent's launcher.sh exports (localhost ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY); `strace -f -e trace=connect -p <claude pid> -o <file>` (fallback: poll `ss -tnpH` every 1s for the claude process tree); `ollama ps`. 5) Confirm LOCAL_OLLAMA_OK.txt (LOCAL_OK) is committed and pushed on feature/pan-3684 and pan task done ran. 6) Kill the agent with `node dist/cli/index.js kill PAN-3684` immediately after evidence capture; under Herdr also check `herdr pane list` and `herdr pane close <id>` any leftover PAN-3684 pane (PAN-3966); close its PR unmerged. Never run pan reload/pan restart while the E2E agent's state row exists. This is the first real test of the tool_result round-trip through Ollama's shim (the planning probe only proved tool_use emission). 7) Write docs/audits/pan-1641-local-ollama-verification.md (date, GPU, Ollama version, model, context length, launch command, env excerpt, connection summary attributing every non-loopback connection to its process, LOCAL_OLLAMA_OK.txt commit SHA, first-turn input tokens). 8) Comment on PAN-3684 linking the audit, then close it. Checkpoints: non-loopback connection from the claude process -> add the matching documented Claude Code disable env var (DISABLE_TELEMETRY, DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING, DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY) to the ollama-launch-env env and PROVIDER_ENV_KEYS, rebuild, re-run; if none applies, record it and `pan tell flywheel-orchestrator`. Context overflow at 65536 -> set the server's OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH to 131072, re-run, record both. gemma4:12b fails the tool loop twice -> record the transcript tail and `pan tell`; never switch models silently. Agent git pushes to GitHub are expected and listed.

metadata.sizeJustification: PAN-1641's own acceptance criteria require the provider/preflight, pan install, pan doctor, pan up, docs, and an E2E in one issue, and splitting them would ship an Ollama provider with no setup path. The ~39-file surface is driven by one new test file per slice, one-line call sites in ratcheted files (src/cli/index.ts, doctor.ts, schema.ts) with their allowlist rows, the skills/composer lockstep pair, and five doc files. Logic lives in eight new small modules. The plan is already 10 vertical items with a DAG that lets install, doctor, provider routing, and docs run in parallel slots.
